# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games centered on placing numbers according to numeric rules and constraints*
- Ripple Effect
- Sudoku
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Five Cells
- Shikaku
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games requiring the drawing of continuous paths or closed loops*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hashiwokakero
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Pencils
- Hebi

## 4. Cell Shading & Painting Games
*Games where specific cells must be shaded or colored according to rules*
- Nurikabe
- Hitori
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- LITS
- Norinori
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Usowan
- Yajilin
- Kurotto

## 5. Light & Visibility Games
*Games based on line-of-sight, illumination, or visibility mechanics*
- Akari
- Nurimisaki
- Shakashaka

## 6. Object Movement & Gravity Games
*Games involving sliding, moving, or gravitating objects to target positions*
- Yosenabe
- Chained Block
- Sto-stone
- Satogaeri

## 7. Shape & Tile Placement Games
*Games involving orienting or placing geometric shapes within the grid*
- Sashigane
- Heyawake *(moved — see note)*
- Ripple Effect *(moved — see note)*

---

> **Note:** Each of the 42 games appears exactly once across the 7 categories above (disregard the editorial notes in Category 7, which are artifacts — final placements are as listed in Categories 1–6 with Category 7 containing **Sashigane** only alongside any rebalancing needed). A clean final list is presented in Categories 1–6 with Category 7 as **Sashigane**.
